description: Three DRY violations: (1) run_normal_cleanup and run_aggressive_cleanup are byte-identical apart from the level symbol - parameterize into run_cleanup(level); keep emergency separate (3x GC + sleeps). (2) The begin/rescue/log-continue pattern is repeated in clear_system_caches (twice), run_registered_handlers, and elsewhere - extract a safe(label : String, &block) helper that logs and swallows. (3) Emergency cleanup blocking the actor mailbox 300ms+ with 3x GC.collect + sleep is worth a comment documenting the tradeoff. Also fix self.reset which uses 'inst.shutdown rescue nil' (inline rescue swallows everything including real shutdown bugs - use an explicit rescue block).
title: DRY cleanup strategies and error-swallow blocks
